title: Triple-check confluence EA: SMA250 distance-filter + reversal candlestick + Stochastic OB/OS with rate-limited grid-add (fxDreema ex.55/56)
entry_long: price above SMA250 AND distance(price,SMA250) < 80 pips AND 3-bar reversal pattern (ID3=bear,ID2=bull,ID1=bull) AND Stochastic crossing up through oversold level 30
entry_short: mirror: price below SMA250, distance <80 pips, reversal pattern (ID3=bull,ID2=bear,ID1=bear), Stochastic crossing down through overbought level 70
exit: winning side: trailing stop 20 pips / step 1 pip (Flow-Trend mode); losing side: switches to Reverse-Trend grid-add mode (no trailing) re-entering same direction every ~15-30 pips (gridDistance / gridDistance*2 formula) with lot +0.05 per add, rate-limited to max 1 add per bar; no stated SL on initial or added orders
escalation_cap: rate-limited to 1 add per bar only; no cap on total number of adds or total lot found
buildon_idea: add a hard total-step cap (e.g. 5-8 adds) and a max-lot ceiling on top of the existing 1-per-bar rate limit; add a structural SL; flat-lot test (remove the +0.05 escalation) before judging edge. Video also briefly covers ex.55 (3-bar impulse/imbalance breakout with trap lines and stop-loss sized off historical consecutive-loss count) and ex.87/108 (breakout variants, one had zero trades on gold = broken) - not detailed here, worth a separate pass if pursued
novelty_note: common indicator-confluence template (align+distance-filter+reversal-candle+oscillator); instructor explicitly notes win% rises with more confluence indicators but trade count drops sharply

title: RSI(period tuned to TF) oversold/overbought + 'special doji' wick-filter reversal entry with martingale add-and-close-on-profit (fxDreema ex.86)
timeframe: unspecified (RSI period 14 for H1+, period 7 for M1-M30)
entry_long: RSI below oversold level 30 AND prior candle is a 'special doji' (lower wick > 2x upper wick AND lower wick > body size)
entry_short: mirror: RSI above overbought level 70 AND prior candle upper wick > 2x lower wick AND upper wick > body size
exit: no SL/TP on first order; on adverse move, adds a martingale/grid order (constant 'lot x2' present in EA constants); position(s) closed once floating profit exceeds a fixed $50 close-money threshold; instructor notes this $50 threshold sacrifices upside on winning trades and drawdown briefly exceeded starting balance over a 5yr test
escalation_cap: unspecified (lot_x2 constant present but exact add-trigger/step and cap not stated in transcript)
buildon_idea: add explicit cap on martingale steps + hard SL; replace fixed $50 close-money exit with a distance/ATR-based target so winners aren't cut short; flat-lot test to confirm entry-side edge before re-adding escalation. Instructor also references ex.128 (same idea, already optimized by a student, PF~2.8x on limited-history test) and a later breakout EA (ex.108ish) using small-lot pyramiding ('ปั่นล็อต') on confirmed breakouts - not detailed here
novelty_note: RSI OB/OS + wick-ratio doji filter is a common combo; instructor frames win%>50% as justification for using martingale-style adds
